bull_case: AI/HPC customers continue migrating to N2/A16 and advanced packaging, supporting price/mix and wallet share.
bear_case: Large customers may dual-source, insource selected silicon strategies, or pressure pricing as concentration rises.
thesis: Customer willingness to pay is strong because yield, density, power efficiency, packaging and delivery directly determine customers' product economics. Concentration increases bargaining and dependency risk but also reflects deep design-cycle integration.

evidence.claim: Largest and second-largest 2025 customers were 19% and 17% of revenue.

counterevidence: Overseas fabs carry structurally higher costs; customer concentration and Taiwan/export-control tail risks remain material.
unknowns: AI/HPC demand duration beyond the current capacity-constrained cycle
falsifiers: A sustained loss of leading-edge share, repeated yield delays, or owner FCF/share stagnation despite rising capex would weaken the thesis.

hard_veto_flags.rationale: Demand is supported by mission-critical manufacturing performance, not subsidy/marketing dependence.

hard_veto_flags.rationale: Customer concentration is material but no single customer, product or regulation is shown to be a fatal dependency; largest customer was 19%, second 17%, with hundreds of customers and multiple end markets.

key_kpis.name: owner FCF/share
key_kpis.threshold: sustained growth through the capex cycle

next_checks: 3Q26 results, N2 ramp, CoWoS/advanced packaging capacity, overseas-fab margin, top-customer concentration

subscores.rationale: For leading-edge customers, access to TSMC process/yield/packaging is mission-critical to performance and time-to-market.
Top customers repeatedly migrate to advanced nodes; advanced-node mix rose from 69% in 2024 to 74% in 2025 and 77% in 2Q26.
High utilization and mix produced 67.7% Q2 gross margin and 60.3% operating margin despite record capex.

uncertainties.rationale: AI-cycle duration, overseas economics and geopolitical/customer concentration remain material uncertainties.
